import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots to show comprehensive insights
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Set style
sns.set_palette("husl")

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Sleep Disorder
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
sleep_disorder_clean = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
for disorder in sleep_disorder_clean.unique():
    mask = sleep_disorder_clean == disorder
    ax1.scatter(df[mask]['Sleep Duration'], df[mask]['Quality of Sleep'], 
                alpha=0.6, label=disorder, s=50)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', loc='best')
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Distribution of Sleep Disorders
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
disorder_counts = sleep_disorder_clean.value_counts()
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", len(disorder_counts))
ax2.pie(disorder_counts.values, labels=disorder_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
        colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax2.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Stress Level vs Physical Activity Level
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
scatter = ax3.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Stress Level'], 
                      c=df['Quality of Sleep'], cmap='RdYlGn', 
                      alpha=0.6, s=50)
ax3.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Stress Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Stress vs Physical Activity\n(colored by Sleep Quality)', 
              fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax3)
cbar.set_label('Sleep Quality', fontsize=9)
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 4. Average Sleep Duration by Occupation
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1:])
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values()
occupation_sleep.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax4, color='steelblue', alpha=0.7)
ax4.set_xlabel('Average Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Average Sleep Duration by Occupation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 5. BMI Category vs Heart Rate
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
bmi_order = ['Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese'] if 'Obese' in df['BMI Category'].unique() else df['BMI Category'].unique()
bmi_order = [b for b in bmi_order if b in df['BMI Category'].unique()]
sns.boxplot(data=df, y='BMI Category', x='Heart Rate', ax=ax5, 
            order=bmi_order, palette='Set2')
ax5.set_xlabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('BMI Category', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Heart Rate Distribution by BMI Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 6. Daily Steps vs Sleep Quality
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
sns.violinplot(data=df, x='Quality of Sleep', y='Daily Steps', ax=ax6, 
               palette='muted')
ax6.set_xlabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Daily Steps Distribution by Sleep Quality', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 7. Age Distribution by Gender
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
for gender in df['Gender'].unique():
    data = df[df['Gender'] == gender]['Age']
    ax7.hist(data, alpha=0.6, label=gender, bins=15)
ax7.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_title('Age Distribution by Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax7.legend()
ax7.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
